# Organization Data Export Checklist

Complete this checklist before transfer.

- [ ] Correct Organization or company code is included.
- [ ] Requested date range is documented.
- [ ] Route identifiers are stable across the period.
- [ ] Stop identifiers are stable across the period where available.
- [ ] Account/customer operational identifiers are stable.
- [ ] Actual route timestamps are present where available.
- [ ] Actual stop timestamps are present where available.
- [ ] Delivery outcomes are present.
- [ ] Non-delivery reason codes are included where applicable.
- [ ] Timezone is documented for all timestamps.
- [ ] Source data dictionary is attached or field meanings are documented.
- [ ] Outcome code dictionary is attached.
- [ ] File names and record counts are recorded in the manifest.
- [ ] File checksums are generated if supported by the Organization process.
- [ ] No unnecessary PII is included.
- [ ] No credentials, passwords, API keys, access tokens, or authorization headers are included.
- [ ] Secure transfer method is approved.
